title: Four US Senators Question SEC Safeguards for Tokenized Stock Trading
why_it_matters: The senators' November 16 letter puts regulatory scrutiny on who can hold tokenized shares after they leave permissioned venues, and whether issuers and retail investors retain enforceable protections. The SEC's response could shape how tokenized-equity platforms operate.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Four US Senators Question SEC Safeguards for Tokenized Stock Trading

Four US senators asked the SEC to clarify anti-money-laundering controls, issuer objections and retail investor protections under its September tokenized-stock exemption.
